headline: Planet Money: how exposed is the US to cyberattacks?
pages: This week brought outages affecting United Airlines, Apple Pay and the FAA, NPR's The Indicator noted, leaving many people wondering about cyberattack risk. The agencies and companies involved insist the failures are unrelated to cyberattacks. Even so, there is growing concern about how vulnerable the US is, given fast-growing AI and what the newsletter calls decidedly fragile infrastructure. As another example, it cited a hack earlier this month on supermarket refrigeration in Europe, where fridges and freezers in grocery stores and butcher shops across seven countries were turned up to more than 100 degrees Fahrenheit.

The newsletter also planned to examine why old software is so risky and why Steam is earning less revenue from new games. The topic matters because business and government rely on digital systems that are expensive to replace. Source: NPR.
